ui.title: Jiedong Zhang · Robotics & Embodied AI
ui.description: Jiedong Zhang: shape-aware motion planning, robot learning and computational physics.
ui.heroTag: Motion Planning · Robot Learning · Computational Physics
ui.heroLead: I explore how robots perceive, plan and act.
ui.heroAbout: I graduated in Applied Physics from Donghua University and completed a minor in Mathematics and Applied Mathematics at Shanghai Jiao Tong University. I test research ideas through algorithm implementation, hardware integration and robot experiments.
ui.heroCurrent: Currently a research intern at MINT Lab, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, and PAIRS Lab, HKUST (Guangzhou), working on robot learning, systems integration and active vision.
ui.piano: Outside research and engineering, I enjoy playing classical piano.
ui.fieldnotesIntro: Exchanging ideas and building prototypes with people from different backgrounds at hackathons and maker events.

research.title: Shape-Aware Motion Planning
research.body: Planning around the geometry of robots and their payloads, with an interest in obstacle avoidance in confined spaces and coordinated motion of bases, payloads and articulated systems.

research.title: Robot Learning
research.body: Reinforcement learning for locomotion and whole-body control, including teacher–student distillation and parameter estimation from observation histories.

research.title: Vision–Language–Action
research.body: Studying how gaze information and visual compression affect VLA action decisions through dataset preparation, model fine-tuning and real-robot evaluation, while exploring coordination between high-level decisions and low-level execution.

research.title: Computational Physics
research.body: Developing physics simulation tools, reproducing published methods and experiments, and building repeatable workflows for experiments and analysis.

projects.name: Active Vision & Hierarchical VLA
projects.body: Studying how gaze information and visual compression affect VLA action decisions, with a focus on coordination between high-level visual decisions and low-level action policies. Led data collection and cleaning, Qwen-based model fine-tuning and data generation, and training and evaluation on Piper. Current work examines the consistency of visual inputs during training and deployment, recording observations, policy outputs and robot feedback for comparative experiments and analysis.
projects.caption: Coin-task data-collection replay: paired external and close-up camera views.

projects.name: Shape-Aware Motion Planning
projects.body: Reproducing SVSDF collision-free motion planning using open-source code from FAST Lab at Zhejiang University. Completed SE(2) planning for a simulated quadruped and am now extending it to SE(3) trajectories. Current work examines how geometric clearance, orientation and local smoothness can jointly guide trajectory optimization, and explores the role of planning information in policy generalization within multi-task reinforcement-learning environments.
projects.caption: SE(3) planning test environments: geometry previews of four scene layouts.

projects.name: OPENARM · VR Teleoperation
projects.body: Contributed to cross-network teleoperation between Meta Quest 3 and OPENARM, Jetson Orin deployment and robot-side integration. My work includes connection maintenance, session handover, transport troubleshooting, and command and feedback logging. Ongoing work checks the consistency between communication and robot execution, and refines the teleoperation and data-recording workflows used in experiments.
projects.caption: OpenArm platform reference image · Enactic / OpenArm official repository.

projects.name: ATEC 2026 · Team ATEpi
projects.body: Led reinforcement-learning experiments and algorithm pipeline design. Reproduced HIMLoco, Extreme Parkour and whole-body control. Two-stage teacher–student distillation achieved 84% task success, while history-based parameter estimation yielded a 0% base-fall rate in the evaluated runs. Scored 36/36 in obstacle traversal; placed 16th overall on the online L1 leaderboard, with a Track 2 score of 52.

projects.name: Anisotropic Complex-Plasma Simulation
projects.body: Developed a Taichi/PyTorch physics simulation engine to study anisotropic complex plasma and reproduce methods from the literature. Integrated memU and the Claude-Scientist backend to automate experiment-data archiving. This work formed part of a national-level undergraduate innovation project and my graduation thesis, and supported data-processing tasks related to the International Space Station.
projects.caption: A simulation result from my public project repository: two-temperature dynamics in a reproduction of Ivlev et al., PRX (2015).

projects.name: Agentcraft · AR / AI Glasses
projects.body: Designed and implemented a 2D-to-3D interaction concept using Tripo3D, 3DGS and AI glasses. Integrated WorldGen and World Labs tools and APIs to develop two proof-of-concept prototypes. Led the team to the Technical Innovation Award at the Rokid Spatial Joy 2025 Global AR & AI Development Competition.
projects.caption: Agentcraft’s trophy and certificate for the Rokid Spatial Joy 2025 Technical Innovation Award, received in January 2026.

projects.name: lazy-paper · Research Knowledge Garden
projects.body: An open-source research tool for paper reading, question development, literature search and experiment notes. A staged workflow produces bilingual analyses with figures and source references, while a knowledge-garden view shows connections between papers, questions and experiments. The public repository includes code, a usage guide and example outputs.
projects.caption: Knowledge-garden interface: connecting papers, questions and experiments. Screenshot from the public project repository.

experience.body: Contribute to active visual tracking research, exploring visual compression and multi-camera information integration to improve VLA robustness to environmental disturbances. Collected, cleaned and organized data, used Qwen-4B for fine-tuning and data generation, and ran PI0 / PI0.5 training and real-robot tests on Piper. Currently preparing a co-first-author submission to RSS 2027, with contributions to manuscript writing, real-robot validation and figures.

experience.org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University · MINT Lab
experience.body: Studied the starVLA architecture and adapted it to benchmark tasks. Contributed to calibration of an extended seven-axis SO101 arm, as well as data collection, training and inference on Piper. Deployed Jetson Orin and built a data link for Meta Quest 3 teleoperation of OPENARM across separate local networks. Created all figures and contributed later-stage writing and detailed review for Evo-RL, submitted to ICRA 2027. Also contributed to Learn the Task, Not the Schedule, a project on spurious coupling in bimanual data, submitted to ICLR 2027.
Contributed to AR technical sharing, campus liaison and XR collaboration. Talked with developers and users at S-Startup, Google DevFest and AdventureX to understand practical needs.
experience.caption: Rokid campus ambassador appointment · September 2025–July 2026.

experience.body: Help organize hackathons, communicate with sponsors and coordinate resources through the NJU Maker Club, while supporting a maker community of more than 500 members.
